# Handoff Document

**Session ID:** pocock-handoff  
**Date:** 2026-10-01  
**Branch:** `master` (main branch: `main`)  

---

## Overview

This was a wide-ranging, multi-session conversation (spanning 2023-05-20 to 2023-05-28 in-fiction dates) with a single user across many unrelated topics. There is **no single codebase or engineering project** being worked on. The conversation is advisory/creative writing in nature. Below is a map of every thread, its status, and any pending work.

---

## Thread Map

### 1. Property Appraisal Complexity Checklist (Complete)
- Produced a table-format checklist (Location, Property type, Age/condition, Zoning, Market conditions) for determining whether an appraisal is complex.
- Defined its purpose: consistent, objective assessment of property complexity and fee justification.
- Revised advisory language about appraiser opinions to be more professional (replaced casual phrases like "automatically make it so" with "conclusively establish its complexity").

### 2. Hiking, Social Media & Book Club (Complete)
- Recommended weather apps (Dark Sky, Mountain Weather Forecast, etc.).
- Gave social media engagement tips and book-club note-taking strategies.
- User did not share their location; suggested AllTrails/TrailLink instead.

### 3. Shakespeare Essay (Complete)
- Combined summaries of Hamlet, The Tempest, and The Winter's Tale into a 3-paragraph essay with intro and conclusion.

### 4. European Soccer Young Talents (Complete)
- Listed promising young players (Mbappe, Haaland, Foden, Fati, Bellingham, Camavinga, Reyna, Wirtz, Gravenberch).
- Discussed pressure on young athletes and work-life balance.

### 5. Jewish Prayer & Kavanah (Complete)
- Listed prayer books with kavanah guides (ArtScroll, Mishkan T'filah, Lev Shalem, etc.).
- Recommended writings on kavanah (Reuven Hammer, Aryeh Kaplan, etc.).
- Discussed reasons for Temple sacrifices and subjects of worship.

### 6. Laptop Recommendations & Online Shopping (Complete)
- Recommended mid-range laptops; user chose Asus Vivobook X512FA.
- Provided cashback/discount sources (Rakuten, TopCashback, etc.).
- Gave tips for organizing online purchases and deal tracking.

### 7. File & Digital Collection Organization (Complete)
- Advised on Windows 11 file organization: folder hierarchy, naming conventions, downloads folder plan.
- Recommended automatic backup via Windows Backup + 3-2-1 rule.
- User has a 1TB Western Digital external drive.
- Covered organizing videos, downloads (Software/Documents/Misc subfolders).
- Discussed handling duplicate files and ambiguous categories (unresolved sub-question the user raised but session moved on).

### 8. Vintage Cameras, Funko POPs, Vinyl Records, Posters (Complete)
- Storage/display advice for 17 vintage cameras (including a Brownie Hawkeye).
- Funko POP! display (complete Marvel Cinematic Universe set).
- Vinyl record storage (has a rare 1978 pressing of Fleetwood Mac's Rumours).
- Poster/art print display (Mondo Hogwarts poster).

### 9. Vietnamese Cuisine Discussion (Complete)
- Discussed Pho, Banh Mi, Bun Cha, Goi Cuon, Banh Xeo, Che.

### 10. Construction Contracts Article Rewrite (Partially Complete)
**Status: This is the most active thread with potential continuation.**

- **Persona:** Homeowner in Adelaide / South Australia, Australia.
- **Voice:** Construction lawyer with 10+ years experience. AU English.
- **SEO keywords:** "types of construction contracts", "construction contracts" (injected naturally).
- **Brand:** "Construction Lawyer Adelaide" (replaces "Contracts Specialist").
- **Parts completed:** Part 8 only (trust/CTA section). Parts 1-7 have NOT been provided or rewritten yet.
- **SEO metadata produced:**
  - Meta Title (NSW variant, <=70 chars): `Expert Construction Contract Review | NSW Homeowners | Construction Lawyer Adelaide`
  - Meta Description (<=155 chars): provided.
  - OG Title (<=60 chars): `Building Contracts NSW: Construction Lawyer Review | Small Builders`
  - OG Description (<=110 chars): provided.
- **Note:** The meta titles/descriptions pivot to NSW despite the article body targeting SA. The user may want SA-specific meta tags or may be building location variants. Clarify if continuing.
- **Pending:** Parts 1-7 of the reference article have not been sent yet. The user said they would send the article "per part."

---

## User Preferences & Corrections Observed

- Prefers professional, formal tone in business/legal writing.
- Dislikes casual phrases in professional contexts (e.g., "automatically make it so").
- Expects AU English for the construction article.
- Comfortable with detailed, list-heavy responses for advisory topics.
- Did not share personal location or PII (declined politely).

---

## Rejected Paths / Dead Ends

- Asking the user for their city/location for hiking recommendations -- they declined.
- Asking about Sarah's location -- user does not share PII of others.

---

## Mental Model

The user engages in wide-ranging Q&A conversations across personal interests (hobbies, food, sports, religion) and professional tasks (appraisal checklists, construction law SEO articles). The construction contracts article rewrite is the only structured, multi-part deliverable in progress. Everything else was one-off advisory.

---

## Required Reading

None -- there are no files in the repo beyond a `.claude/` directory. All work product lives in chat history.

---

## Running Jobs / Pending Actions

None.

---

## Suggested Skills

If the next session continues the **construction contracts article rewrite**:
- No special skills needed; standard writing and SEO expertise suffice.

If the user pivots to new tasks:
- **`shift-brief`** -- if they want to package a sub-task for a collaborator.
- **`deep-research`** -- if they want rigorous research on any of the advisory topics.
- **`example-skills:docx`** -- if they want the article exported as a Word document.
- **`example-skills:pdf`** -- if they want the article exported as a PDF.
